mapper.delete: DELETE FROM common_site_reservation WHERE member_account = #{memberAccount} AND reservation_date = #{reservationDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO common_site_reservation (reservation_date, period, member_account) VALUES (#{reservationDate}, #{period}, #{memberAccount})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM common_site_reservation WHERE reservation_date = #{reservationDate} AND period = #{period}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM common_site_reservation WHERE signed_in = 0 AND DATE_ADD( reservation_date, INTERVAL CASE period WHEN 1 THEN '09:00' WHEN 2 THEN '15:00' WHEN 3 THEN '19:00' END HOUR_MINUTE ) < DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', '+08:00'), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)
